positions.title: Outside Service and Pro Shop Assistant
positions.description:
•	Managed tee times, member services, and retail services
•	Managed 10 outside service workers by providing feedback and delegating tasks to maintain smooth operation of all golf related activities
•	Provided helpful and friendly service to all members and guests
•	Interacted with and served members in all golf related activities
•	Helped run outside events and member events (golf tournaments) with other colleagues
•	Maintained smooth operation of all golf related activities (cart fleet management, practice facility maintenance)
